answer_1.quote: The task of KG-to-text generation has been proposed to make this structured information more accessible to humans, aiming to generate fluent, informative, and faithful natural-language sentences that should describe the contents of an input KG.

answer_2.quote: We use automatic metrics to measure both fluency and faithfulness of generated text. Following existing KG-to-text work, we employ standard metrics BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE-L.

answer_3.quote: We propose to utilize ChatGPT to further measure the factual consistency and fluency of the generated text with respect to the input graph.
